_meta.status: Best-effort AI-assisted translation for the SIH26003 prototype — not yet reviewed by a native speaker or community linguist. Treat as a solid starting draft, not a certified translation; please correct before any real deployment in Nagaland/Assam.
_meta.script: Nagamese is written in the Latin alphabet, as used here.
_meta.fallback: Any key missing here falls back to English automatically (see i18n/index.ts).

common.tryAgain: Aru ekbar cheshta koribi, joldi nai
common.personalBest: Apuni age pora bhal hoi thakise!
common.takeBreakBody: Apuni bosi khela korise. Olop aram bhal hobo.
common.clinicalNote: SmritiSetu mon laga kaam bhal koribole aru somoy logote ki bodol hoise etu dekhibole modot kore. Etu kunu rogor porikha nohoi. Daktor logot kotha koribi.

roles.choosePrompt: Etiya SmritiSetu kun use koridi ase?

onboarding.chooseLanguageBody: Juntu bhasha te apuni aram pai etu chapi dibi.
onboarding.consentBody: SmritiSetu-e rogi laga sob tothyo — naam, khela khela, aru unnoti — khali ei device-tei rakhe. Apuni sync koribole nabhabile, kunu tothyo ei device-r bahir-loi najabo.
onboarding.consentPointStorage: Sob data default-e ei device-tei thake, internet nathakile bhi.
onboarding.consentPointControl: Apuni jekono somoi-te Admin Panel pora sob data export koribo pare nohoile hodai-loi delete koribo pare.
onboarding.consentPointNotDiagnosis: SmritiSetu-e mon-r kaam-t modot kore — ei ekta medical diagnosis nohoi.
onboarding.consentAgree: Moi bujisi aru moi mani loise
onboarding.setupCaregiverPin: Dekha-bhal koridi thaka manu laga 4 number PIN bonabi
onboarding.setupCompleteBody: SmritiSetu etiya use koribole taiyar ase, internet nathakile bhi.

errorBoundary.title: Kiba samasya hoise
errorBoundary.body: SmritiSetu-t ekta samasya hoise. Kunu data harai nai — apuni ghuri jaike aru ekbar cheshta koribo pare.

caregiverAuth.title: Dekha-bhal koridi thaka manu laga login
caregiverAuth.wrongPin: Ei PIN thik nohoi. Aru ekbar cheshta koribi.
caregiverAuth.tooManyAttempts: Bisi bar golti hoise. {{seconds}} second pichot aru cheshta koribi.
caregiverAuth.scanQr: Nohoile apuni laga QR code scan koribi

adminAuth.title: Admin login
adminAuth.wrongPin: Ei PIN thik nohoi. Aru ekbar cheshta koribi.

adminPanel.resetAllDataBody: Ei kaam pora ei device laga sob data hodai laga bhabe mussi jabo. Cholai jabole "{{word}}" likhibi.

levelSelect.title: Level Basi Lobi
levelSelect.body: Kunu bondo nai — juntu level lage bosi kena khela koribi. Hodai khela laga babe SmritiSetu nijorai pora ekta level koi thakibo.

patientHome.todaysSetBody: Aji laga bacha tin ta khela

reminders.title: Aji
reminders.noneToday: Etiya kiba thik nai. Bhal korise!
reminders.label: Etu ki laga?

familyManager.title: Poriwar aru mukh khan
familyManager.body: Naam Yaad khela laga bahar photo, naam aru awaz jusi dibi.
familyManager.name: Naam
familyManager.noMembers: Etiya tak kunu manu jusa nai.

dashboard.title: Dekha-bhal koridi thaka manu laga dashboard
dashboard.domainBalanceBody: {{name}} sob 5 ta field te kineka somoke khela ase
dashboard.cognitiveInsightsBody: Field khan laga trend, ei rogi laga nijor session pora he bahar hoise — dui ta point compare kora nohoi, aru kunu dusra manu laga data logot compare kora nohoi.
dashboard.disclaimer: Ei dashboard te daktor logot kotha koribole trend dekhai. Etu kunu rogor porikha nohoi.
dashboard.noData: Etiya tak data nai — poila kisu khela koribi.
dashboard.reminderAlertsBody: Dawai, pani, nohoile activity-r somoi hoile ei device-t alert pabo — SmritiSetu khula thakile, background-o kaam kore. Ei ekdom bondho tab-ke uthabo napare.
dashboard.reminderAlertsDenied: Permission block hoise. Etu on koribole apnar browser nohoile device settings-t ei site-r babe notification enable koribi.

orientationCheckin.whatTime: Etiya din laga kun somoy ase?

smriti-cards.name: Smriti Cards
smriti-cards.instructions: Milikena thaka card duita bisari bi. Kun photo kot ase etu mon te rakhibole cheshta koribi.
smriti-cards.clinicalMapping: Photo jora milai kena purana kotha mon te loi kena rakha (MoCA) aru chini pora (ADAS-Cog) logote milise.

smriti-katha.name: Smriti Katha
smriti-katha.instructions: Ekta chutu kahani hunibi, tar pichot photo basi kena tar bare te sawal laga jowab dibi.
smriti-katha.clinicalMapping: Hodai koi thaka kahani pora mon te loi kena rakha aru sobdo mon te thaka (MoCA, ADAS-Cog) logote milise.

naam-yaad.name: Naam Yaad
naam-yaad.instructions: Apuni chini thaka manu laga photo ahibo. Tai laga thik naam ta chapi dibi.
naam-yaad.clinicalMapping: Rogi laga asol poriwar laga photo loi kena manu chini pora (MoCA/ADAS-Cog) logote milise.

dhyan-dhaam.name: Dhyan Dhaam
dhyan-dhaam.instructions: Upor te dikhai thaka rong-dhong logot milikena thaka sob tile te chapi dibi.
dhyan-dhaam.clinicalMapping: Lagatar mon dibole aru bisi kotha te pora hisab (MoCA, ADAS-Cog) logote milise.

ginti-dhyan.name: Ginti Dhyan
ginti-dhyan.instructions: Number khan sob pora sano pora shuru kori kena, ginti laga kromot chapi dibi.
ginti-dhyan.clinicalMapping: Mon dibole aru kaam koridi thaka mon te thaka kotha (MoCA digit span) logote milise, bura manu khan laga gati te.

awaaz-pehchan.name: Awaaz Pehchan
awaaz-pehchan.instructions: Mon dikena hunibi. Lokkho sobdo nohoile awaz hunile he button chapi dibi.
awaaz-pehchan.clinicalMapping: Lagatar awaz te mon dibole (MoCA attention) logote milise, purah pora awaz pora he, kom pori thaka rogi khan laga babe.

dinacharya-sequence.name: Dinacharya Sequence
dinacharya-sequence.instructions: Photo laga card khan apuni hodai din te kora kromot lagai dibi.
dinacharya-sequence.clinicalMapping: Hodai laga kaam laga plan aru krom (IADL) logote milise.

bazaar-list.name: Bazaar List
bazaar-list.instructions: Bazar laga list hunibi, tar pichot khali oi khan he grid te bisaribi.
bazaar-list.clinicalMapping: Hodai laga kaam laga list mon te rakha aru IADL plan logote milise.

ghar-ka-kaam.name: Ghar ka Kaam
ghar-ka-kaam.instructions: Ekta ghor laga tool chapi dibi, tar pichot oi kaam ta chapi dibi juntu te tool ta use hoi.
ghar-ka-kaam.clinicalMapping: Hodai laga jinis logot kaam laga sombondho (IADL assessment te poila dikha jaga) logote milise.

aakar-milan.name: Aakar Milan
aakar-milan.instructions: Juntu tukra pora rong-dhong ta thik pora pura hoi etu bisaribi.
aakar-milan.clinicalMapping: Chokh pora dikhi kena jaga chini pora aru kaam kora hisab (MoCA visuospatial, ADAS-Cog) logote milise.

chaya-khoj.name: Chaya Khoj
chaya-khoj.instructions: Jinis ta sabi, tar pichot tai laga milikena thaka sai ta chapi dibi.
chaya-khoj.clinicalMapping: Chokh pora dikhi kena jaga milai pora (MoCA visuospatial) logote milise, porha laga dorkar nai.

naksha-jodo.name: Naksha Jodo
naksha-jodo.instructions: Dangor tukra khan mili kena photo ta bonabi. Somoy loi kena koribi.
naksha-jodo.clinicalMapping: Bonabole aru gathon kora hisab (ADAS-Cog), ghori aki thaka kaam laga ekta aram laga rup.

aaj-ka-din.name: Aaj Ka Din
aaj-ka-din.instructions: Aji laga bare te kisu shaanti sawal laga jowab dibi.
aaj-ka-din.clinicalMapping: Somoy aru jaga bujha (MoCA orientation) logote milise. Etu hodai laga cheking, hisab laga abhyas nohoi.
